requirements.text: RUN LANE 1 ('run 3 codex loops'): feed and launch codex loop lane 1 (SupervisorController) on a contracted, claimed, in-regime ledger packet under the normal gated process and the D-070 finished-seam standard (packet contracted+claimed+pushed, worktree at/past the claim seam, launcher pointed, fresh run-id, stale asks denied in BOTH stores first). This authorizes lane-1 occupancy NOW: it supersedes the seq-125 handoff's 'loop-1 re-feeds after the T071 accept' sequencing for lane occupancy only; the M5-T071 submit/accept itself still follows its own gates unchanged.
requirements.required_harness: Lane-1 packet contract seam recorded in the ledger (new-task, binds, G0, claim); launch journal shows a healthy fresh run on that packet.
requirements.required_evidence: Ledger task files + claim seam commit + the lane-1 run journal/launch record.
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; the concrete lane-1 packet id binds via applicability.task_ids at its contract seam.

requirements.text: RUN LANE 2 ('run 3 codex loops'): feed and launch codex loop lane 2 (SupervisorController2) on a contracted, claimed, in-regime ledger packet under the same normal gated process and D-070 finished-seam standard as R001 (the seq-125 handoff already permitted loop-2 re-feed 'anytime'; named candidates: DB-045(a) real-parcel bridge-mount validation, T069-G3-A2 revoke-text pin — candidate choice stays the orchestrator's).
requirements.required_harness: Lane-2 packet contract seam recorded in the ledger (new-task, binds, G0, claim); launch journal shows a healthy fresh run on that packet.
requirements.required_evidence: Ledger task files + claim seam commit + the lane-2 run journal/launch record.
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; the concrete lane-2 packet id binds via applicability.task_ids at its contract seam.

requirements.text: KEEP LANE 3 RUNNING ('run 3 codex loops'): codex loop lane 3 (SupervisorController3) stays live on its current M5-T070 increment-2 run (persistent3-local-17); do not restart or displace it on this directive. On its natural close, harvest per the recorded drill and re-feed the lane so three lanes stay concurrently occupied while in-regime work remains available. The satisfied state is all three lanes live (or a lane momentarily between harvest and re-feed at a seam).
requirements.required_harness: Loop-3 watcher armed; run journal shows the live run undisturbed; at close, the harvest + re-feed seam recorded in the ledger.
requirements.required_evidence: Run journal for persistent3-local-17 + the harvest/re-feed seam commits.
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; loop-3 already live and undisturbed at capture. Sentinel-bound only: lane occupancy is an operational duty evidenced by the run journal, never a work-content obligation of the M5-T070 packet (which predates this directive and stays untouched mid-run).
